name: syncro-electron-desktop
description: Syncro Deployer — Multi-Cloud DevSecOps Electron.js Desktop Workbench (AWS · GCP · Azure CLI MCP, Dual-Mode Deployer, VM FinOps & Guardrailed Ops Bot)
author: Syncro Suite Team <ops@syncrosuite.io>

scripts.build: npm run build:icons && npm run build:renderer
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable zip
scripts.pack:linux: npm run build && npm run build:native && electron-builder --linux AppImage tar.gz deb rpm
scripts.pack:mac: npm run build && npm run build:native && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
